source_verified_words: sən hansısa bir dərman qəbul edirsən

coverage.method: Full sequential AI review of all current Azerbaijani/English definitions, POS and extra senses; every row with available dictionary, native dump or print evidence was compared with at least one relevant supplied source. Dedicated secondary sweep covered all 811 entries/1,459 pairs. Concise original bilingual paraphrases were authored for clear errors and many circular definitions. Unsupported entries received only an AI plausibility screen; some short translation-style glosses remain. Source comparison is not professional certification.
coverage.secondary_sense_policy: Every original secondary pair was assessed explicitly. Clear AZ/EN false friends were repaired; supported senses were retained, restored, or combined in sensePairs. Unresolved lexical conflicts and relation risks remain in holds. The final 171 entries/302 pairs were reviewed by a delegated agent and merged after comparison. This is AI-assisted editorial/source review, not professional linguistic certification.
coverage.source_limitations: Native dump pages can contain wrong-language entries or copied glosses (including tasma, qoy, sad, salt, sir, soru, roomys and qor); print material includes historical or outdated scientific descriptions. Conflicts were resolved where supporting evidence was available and otherwise retained as explicit holds.
